above normal: The weather report says temperatures this week will stay above normal, so remember to drink plenty of water.
氣象報告說本週氣溫將維持在高於正常值，所以記得多喝水。
return to normal: After the typhoon passed, it took almost a week for life in the small village to return to normal.
颱風過後，這個小村莊花了將近一週的時間生活才恢復正常。
perfectly normal: The doctor told the nervous mother that it is perfectly normal for babies to cry at night.
醫生告訴那位緊張的母親，嬰兒晚上哭是完全正常的。
normal working hours: Most office workers in the city prefer normal working hours, from nine in the morning to six in the evening.
城裡大多數上班族偏好正常工時，從早上九點到晚上六點。
in the normal course of events: In the normal course of events, a letter sent today should reach Tainan within two days.
在正常情況下，今天寄出的信應該兩天內會送達台南。
a normal distribution: When the teacher drew a graph of the test scores, they formed a normal distribution, with most students near the average.
老師把考試成績畫成圖時，成績呈現常態分布，大多數學生都接近平均值。
a noticeable improvement: Since Tom started reading English novels every night, there has been a noticeable improvement in his writing.
自從湯姆每晚開始讀英文小說，他的寫作有了明顯的改善。
a noticeable difference: After the new street lights were installed, there was a noticeable difference in how safe people felt walking home.
新路燈裝好之後，人們走路回家時的安全感有了明顯的差異。
be barely noticeable: The small scratch on my phone screen is barely noticeable unless you hold it under a bright light.
除非你把手機放在強光下，否則螢幕上的小刮痕幾乎看不出來。
nuclear power: Some people believe nuclear power is a clean energy source, while others worry about accidents and waste.
有些人認為核能是乾淨的能源，另一些人則擔心意外與廢料。
a nuclear family: In modern cities, many people live in a nuclear family made up of just parents and their children.
在現代城市裡，許多人住在只由父母和孩子組成的核心家庭。
nuclear weapons: World leaders met to discuss how to stop more countries from building nuclear weapons that could destroy whole cities.
各國領袖開會討論如何阻止更多國家製造可能摧毀整座城市的核武。
the nuclear option: When talks with the company failed, the workers chose the nuclear option and went on strike for a month.
和公司談判失敗後，工人們選擇了最極端的手段，罷工了一個月。
nuclear waste: Nobody in the town wants nuclear waste to be stored near their homes because it stays dangerous for thousands of years.
鎮上沒有人希望核廢料存放在家附近，因為它會危險數千年。
on numerous occasions: I have reminded my brother on numerous occasions to lock the door, but he still forgets almost every day.
我已經許多次提醒弟弟要鎖門，但他還是幾乎每天都忘記。
numerous attempts: After numerous attempts to fix the old printer himself, my father finally gave up and bought a new one.
在多次嘗試自己修理那台舊印表機之後，我爸爸終於放棄並買了一台新的。
too numerous to mention: The singer has won awards too numerous to mention, including several Golden Melody Awards.
這位歌手獲得的獎項多到無法一一列舉，包括好幾座金曲獎。
a nutritious meal: After the long hike, Grandma cooked us a nutritious meal with fish, rice, and plenty of fresh vegetables.
長途健行之後，奶奶為我們煮了一頓有魚、米飯和大量新鮮蔬菜的營養的一餐。
highly nutritious: Sweet potatoes are cheap but highly nutritious, so many families in Taiwan eat them for breakfast.
地瓜便宜卻營養豐富，所以台灣許多家庭早餐都吃地瓜。
be obedient to one's parents: In many traditional families, children are expected to be obedient to their parents and follow their advice.
在許多傳統家庭中，孩子被期望要聽從父母，遵循他們的建議。
an obedient dog: Max is an obedient dog; he sits and waits quietly whenever his owner tells him to.
麥克斯是一隻聽話的狗；每當主人叫他坐下等，他都會安靜照做。
obedient servants: In the old movie, the king was surrounded by obedient servants who did whatever he ordered without question.
在那部老電影裡，國王身邊圍繞著順從的僕人，對他的任何命令都毫不質疑地照做。
an objective assessment: The coach asked an outside expert for an objective assessment of the team's performance, free from personal feelings.
教練請一位外部專家對球隊的表現做出不帶個人情感的客觀的評估。
remain objective: As a judge in the speech contest, Ms. Lin tried to remain objective even though her own student was competing.
身為演講比賽的評審，林老師即使自己的學生參賽，仍努力保持客觀。
objective reality: The scientist explained that facts describe objective reality, which does not change based on what we feel or believe.
這位科學家解釋，事實描述的是客觀現實，它不會因為我們的感受或信念而改變。
an objective (n.): Our main objective this semester is to help every student pass the English speaking test.
我們這學期的主要目標是幫助每位學生通過英語口說測驗。
an obscure poet: The book was written by an obscure poet whose name few people knew until a famous singer used her words.
這本書是一位不知名的詩人所寫，直到一位知名歌手用了她的詩句，才少有人知道她的名字。
for some obscure reason: For some obscure reason, the train stopped in the middle of the field for half an hour, and no one explained why.
出於某種不明原因，火車在田野中間停了半小時，也沒有人解釋為什麼。
an obscure reference: The joke in the movie contained an obscure reference to an old poem, so most of the audience did not laugh.
電影裡的笑話包含一個晦澀難懂的引述，出自一首古老的詩，所以大部分觀眾都沒笑。
obscure the truth: The company tried to obscure the truth about the pollution by hiding important reports from the public.
那家公司試圖藉由對大眾隱藏重要報告來掩蓋關於汙染的真相。
remain obscure: Even after years of research, the exact cause of the strange disease remains obscure to doctors.
即使經過多年研究，這種怪病的確切成因對醫生來說仍然不清楚。
